source: const c = cone(24,30,{at:[0,0,0]}); const s = sphere(12,{at:[8,0,5]}); cut(c,s)

truckFeatures.refusal: A cone combined with a cylinder, cone or ball that is not on the cone's own axis either fails or takes minutes here, so this cut() is not built; put the other shape on the cone's axis, or use a box-shaped tool.
